> A compact wireless macro controller featuring 6 programmable buttons and 3 analog controls. The device will connect to a computer via Bluetooth and run on a rechargeable LiPo battery. The custom PCB will integrate the ESP32, buttons, potentiometers, battery management, USB-C charging, power switch, and status LED. The goal of this project is to design a complete, compact, and functional PCB that can later be assembled and enclosed in a custom 3D-printed case.

### 2026-10-05 — ## 05/10/2026 — I’m starting the Wireless Mini Stream Deck PCB project!

**2h**

## 05/10/2026 — I’m starting the Wireless Mini Stream Deck PCB project!

Today, I thought about what I could build. The idea of a small wireless Stream Deck powered by a battery seemed like a good project to start with. I had to list the components that would be useful, and I decided to use 6 buttons and 3 potentiometers.

After that, I created my GitHub repository. Finally, I started designing my PCB in KiCad. I had never done this before, so I think I’ll need to follow a few tutorials to understand how it works properly.

The project is starting slowly but surely!
